info.title: Harbour API
info.description: Harbour's public API for host apps, such as Lleverage, and for Harbour's own console, which uses it like any other client.

post.description: Starts a session of an agent profile in a project, and sends it `message` when there is one. Needs the operator role on the project. If the first message is refused, the session is closed and the refusal answered.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The sessions the caller may see, newest first, a page at a time.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Sessions with every one of these labels, each sent as `label.<key>=<value>`, such as `label.docketTask=TASK-3347`.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).
The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Ends the session for good: its sandbox leases, browser sessions and grants end. Closing a closed session does nothing.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Stops what the session is doing now. The session stays open and takes new messages.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Sends the session's agent a message, `via` a prompt, a steer or a follow-up. The answer arrives on the session's stream. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retry can't send it twice: a retry with the same key answers the first call's submission without sending anything, and one with another `via` is a `conflict`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The session as `@harbour/protocol` frames: `hello`, then a `snapshot` of its state and latest items (or, with `after`, the deltas after that cursor when the stream still holds them), then a `delta` for every change, live. Fold them with the protocol's `applyFrames`. Over a WebSocket, compressed where the platform can, or as server-sent events.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume after this cursor (a snapshot's or a delta's): the stream sends the deltas after it, or a snapshot when it no longer holds them.

101.description: Upgraded to a WebSocket (send `Upgrade: websocket`). Each message is a JSON array of frames; an empty array is a keep-alive. The server negotiates `permessage-deflate` where the platform can. The client sends nothing; to resume, reconnect with `?after=` and the last cursor it holds.

200.description: The stream. Without an upgrade: server-sent events, each named after its frame's type with the frame as its JSON data, then one `ready` event once the client has caught up. Snapshot and delta events carry their cursor as the event ID, so `Last-Event-ID` resumes too.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The session's transcript in pages, newest first, for scrolling back past a snapshot's items: start with `before` set to the snapshot's `items[0].id`, then follow `nextCursor`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Items older than this item ID, such as a snapshot's `items[0].id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many items. Default 50, cut to 200.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The published skills the caller sees, by name: the platform's, the organisation's, the project's named by `projectId` and, for a person, their own. Never another project's or another person's.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also list this project's skills. Needs the viewer role on it.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

200.description: The skill's package: its owner, latest revision and source.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).
The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: A published revision: its digest, its files' paths and sizes, who published it and where it came from.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.summary: Read a file of a revision
get.description: One file of a published revision, such as its `SKILL.md`, by its path in the package.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path in the package, such as `SKILL.md`.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.summary: Import a skill from a host's source
post.description: A host adapter's publish path: creates the skill if needed and publishes the files as its next revision, once per `source` (`sourceId` and `ref`); files identical to the latest revision publish nothing. People and API keys only, never an agent; a deployment may ask for more, such as the organisation's admin role.

200.description: The revision the files are now.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The spaces the caller may read, oldest first: the organisation's, a project's to those who may view it, and a person's own. A person never sees another person's space.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: People and API keys only, never an agent; a deployment may ask for more, such as the organisation's admin role.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: By ID, every status unless `status` names one.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

parameters.name: conceptId
parameters.description: The concept's ID, its slashes encoded (`projects%2Fharbour%2Fregion`).

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Keyword search over the named spaces' concepts, best first, as a person browsing them would.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: What a session would be given for this query: the profile, the best matches (BM25) and their exceptions, rendered, with a manifest of what was recalled and why.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.summary: Load a snapshot into a space
post.description: A host adapter's load path: the space's concepts become the snapshot's, recorded with its source and ref, so every recall names what it read. People and API keys only; a deployment may ask for more.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The organisation's schedules the caller may see, a page at a time. A project's schedules are listed only to those with the viewer role on it.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: What runs. A `task` starts a session with its payload `{ "agentId"?, "prompt" }` and sends the prompt exactly as written; a `check` runs its payload (a command line or an argument list) with no model.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Exactly one of `at` (a one-off) and `repeat`. A task's runs each start a session, in the schedule's project (the default project for one owned by the organisation or a user), running the payload's agent with its prompt sent exactly as written. Agents may not create schedules. Needs the operator role on a project-owned schedule's project.

201.description: The new schedule, with its first due time.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).
The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

patch.description: Changes the fields given and works out the next due time again. A change that leaves the schedule never due again ends it.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

delete.description: Ends the schedule for good: nothing more runs. It stays listed, as `ended`, with its run history and the sessions its runs started. Ending an ended schedule does nothing.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Nothing runs while it is paused.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

post.description: Runs from the next due time after now; the paused time is not made up.

200.description: The resumed schedule, with its next due time.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.summary: Preview a schedule's next due times

200.description: The next due times, from now.

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

get.description: The run history, a page at a time: each occurrence's status and times, and its result. A task's result names the session it started (`sessionId`).

401.description: The request needs a valid credential (`unauthenticated`).

bearer.description: A host app's API key (`hbr_…`), from the API keys page or `POST /v1/keys`. It acts as a `service` actor, limited to the key's projects and role. Behind Cloudflare Access a person's browser is signed in by Access instead, with no header.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: Who acted: a person, a host app's API key, an agent or Harbour itself.

streaming.description: True while tokens are still arriving.

Attention.title: Attention
Attention.description: How a session list groups the session: working, waiting on someone, or done.

reraiseHours.description: Hours before a finding still present is raised again. Default 6.

risingFactor.description: A finding whose value grows by this factor is raised again. Default 2.

failuresBeforeRaise.description: Failed runs in a row before a `check-failed` finding is raised. Default 3.

severityOrder.description: Severities, worst first, case-insensitive, for raising a finding that got worse as `escalated`. Default `urgent`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `warn`, `info`.

sources.description: What backs it: URLs, `owner/repo@commit:path:lines`, ticket IDs.

staleAfter.description: After this, recall marks it stale (epoch milliseconds).

extensions.description: Namespaced host data Harbour keeps but doesn't read, such as Lleverage's `lleverage.workflows`.

setBy.description: `owner`: set by the space's owner. `learned`: from an approved agent proposal.

ConceptScope.title: ConceptScope
ConceptScope.description: Where a concept applies. A `job` concept is an exception for one job.

agentId.description: The agent profile the session runs.

CreatedSession.title: CreatedSession
CreatedSession.description: A new session, with its first message's submission when it was sent one.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/London`.

at.description: A one-off at this instant (epoch milliseconds). Exactly one of `at` and `repeat`.

until.description: No occurrence is due after this (epoch milliseconds).

CreateScheduleBody.title: CreateScheduleBody
CreateScheduleBody.description: A new schedule. Needs the operator role on a project-owned schedule's project.

projectId.description: The project the session runs in.

workspaceId.description: An existing workspace to run in.

parentSessionId.description: Creates a child session owned by this parent; aborting the parent aborts it.

CreateSessionBody.title: CreateSessionBody
CreateSessionBody.description: Put the host's own reference for the session in `labels`, such as `{ lleverageRunId: "run-42" }`, and find it again with `GET /sessions?label.lleverageRunId=run-42`.

Cursor.title: Cursor
Cursor.description: An opaque position in a session's stream.

DeltaOp.title: DeltaOp
DeltaOp.description: `append` adds an item, `replace` swaps the item with the same id, `text` appends streamed text to an assistant item, and `status`, `title` and `usage` set the session's.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: Every error: the HarbourError's code and message.

model.description: A model ID the session may use, for this run and the session's later runs. Absent keeps the session's model.

FirstMessage.title: FirstMessage
FirstMessage.description: The session's first prompt, sent as soon as it exists.

files.description: Every file of the package, `SKILL.md` among them.

extensions.description: Namespaced host data Harbour keeps but doesn't read, such as Lleverage's `lleverage.workflows`.

includeInactive.description: Also list superseded and forgotten concepts, scoring a quarter.

snippet.description: The first statement line holding a term, cut to 160 characters.

MemorySnapshot.title: MemorySnapshot
MemorySnapshot.description: A whole space's concepts at one ref of a source.

MemorySnapshotRef.title: MemorySnapshotRef
MemorySnapshotRef.description: Where a space's snapshot came from, and when it was imported.

model.description: A model ID the session may use, for this run and the session's later runs. Absent keeps the session's model.

MessageBody.title: MessageBody
MessageBody.description: A message to the session's agent. `via` defaults to `prompt`.

MessageVia.title: MessageVia
MessageVia.description: How a message reaches the agent: `prompt` starts a run (queued behind one in progress), `steer` reaches a run in progress at its next model call, and `followUp` runs after the current run ends.

id.description: `<scheduleId>@<dueAt>`: unique per schedule and due time.

coalesced.description: How many due times this run stands for (more than 1 after missed runs).

result.description: How the run went: a task's `{ sessionId, submissionId }` (the session it started), a check's `{ exitCode, raised }`, or `{ error }` for a failed run.

OwnerRef.title: OwnerRef
OwnerRef.description: Who owns a record: an organisation, a project, a user, or the platform.

manifest.description: What was recalled and why, in the same order.

text.description: The recall as a prompt shows it.

query.description: The task or message text to search by.

profile.description: Concept IDs recalled whatever the query, within their own limits.

anyOf.description: Every `interval` minutes or hours counted from `from`, unaffected by daylight saving.

at.description: A local wall-clock time, `HH:MM`, in the schedule's time zone.
A local wall-clock time, `HH:MM`, in the schedule's time zone.
A local wall-clock time, `HH:MM`, in the schedule's time zone.
A local wall-clock time, `HH:MM`, in the schedule's time zone.

anyOf.description: `day` 31 means the last day of the month.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/London`.

at.description: A one-off at this instant (epoch milliseconds). Exactly one of `at` and `repeat`.

until.description: No occurrence is due after this (epoch milliseconds).

nextDueAt.description: The next due time; absent when ended or paused.

occurrences.description: Occurrences so far; a coalesced one counts once.

ScheduleKind.title: ScheduleKind
ScheduleKind.description: What runs. A `task` starts a session with its payload `{ "agentId"?, "prompt" }` and sends the prompt exactly as written; a `check` runs its payload (a command line or an argument list) with no model.

dueAt.description: The next due times, soonest first.

resumed.description: True when deltas after the client's cursor follow, false for a snapshot.

ServerFrame.title: ServerFrame
ServerFrame.description: One frame of `@harbour/protocol`: `hello`, then a `snapshot` (or the deltas after the client's cursor), then live `delta`s.

nextCursor.description: Present when older items exist; pass it as `cursor`.

agentId.description: The agent profile the session runs.

items.description: The latest page of items, oldest first.

path.description: A relative path inside the package, such as `SKILL.md` or `scripts/run.sh`.

SkillFileContent.title: SkillFileContent
SkillFileContent.description: One file of a revision, as UTF-8 text.

path.description: Where a session finds it, such as `/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md`.

SkillListing.title: SkillListing
SkillListing.description: What a session is shown of a skill: enough to decide whether to read it.

name.description: Unique per owner: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

draftDigest.description: Present while a draft is open.

revision.description: 1, 2, 3… per skill. A published revision never changes.

digest.description: Hex SHA-256 over the sorted paths and contents.

extensions.description: Namespaced host data Harbour keeps but doesn't read, such as Lleverage's `lleverage.workflows`.

sources.description: What backs it: URLs, `owner/repo@commit:path:lines`, ticket IDs.

staleAfter.description: After this, recall marks it stale (epoch milliseconds).

extensions.description: Namespaced host data Harbour keeps but doesn't read, such as Lleverage's `lleverage.workflows`.

setBy.description: `owner`: set by the space's owner. `learned`: from an approved agent proposal.

SnapshotConcept.title: SnapshotConcept
SnapshotConcept.description: One concept as a host's source holds it.

sourceId.description: The host's skill or memory source, such as `sal-skills`.

ref.description: Its ref: a commit or a version.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Where a host's adapter imported something from.

id.description: The submission's ID, which names the run the message started or joined.

label.description: A plain-language label, such as "Reading notes/x.md".

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/London`.

at.description: A one-off at this instant (epoch milliseconds), or `null` to clear it, as when it becomes a recurrence. Exactly one of `at` and `repeat` is left set.

repeat.description: The recurrence, or `null` to clear it, as when it becomes a one-off.

until.description: No occurrence is due after this (epoch milliseconds), or `null` to drop the end date.

count.description: At most this many occurrences, or `null` to drop the run limit.

UpdateScheduleBody.title: UpdateScheduleBody
UpdateScheduleBody.description: The fields to change; a field left out stays as it is, and `null` on `at`, `repeat`, `until` or `count` clears it. The owner and the kind are fixed at create.

VaultApprovalCard.title: VaultApprovalCard
VaultApprovalCard.description: A vault proposal waiting on a person. The secret is never part of it.
